name: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity

meta.wiki: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity

summary: Lieutenant Rukag dispatches Horde defenders to combat the Scourge forces that have dared to encamp outside the Undercity. Agents are tasked with investigating ominous, glowing runic circles linked to the dread necropolis overhead and retrieving Dim Necrotic Stones as proof of their destruction.

sections.title: On the Doorstep
sections.body: The Scourge invasion pushes right to the gates of Lordaeron's fallen capital. Rather than hiding behind the fortified gates of the Undercity, Horde commanders like Lieutenant Rukag organize an immediate counter-offensive to eradicate the encroaching dead before they can mount an assault.

sections.title: Necrotic Relics
sections.body: Outside the citadel, the Scourge have erected glowing runic circles pulsing with foul necromantic energies that resonate with the floating necropolises darkening the skies. Defeating these Scourge trespassers yields Dim Necrotic Stones, dark focuses used to fuel their terrifying rituals and sustain their unnatural march.

faq.q: Who orders the investigation outside the Undercity?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Rukag, a Horde officer stationed to defend the Undercity, commands warriors to investigate the growing Scourge presence outside the gates and cut down their forces.
Dim Necrotic Stones are shadowy magical artifacts carried by the invading Scourge. They hum with foul necromancy and serve as proof of their demise when returned to Horde officers.

faq.q: What are the glowing runic circles?
faq.answer: They are ritualistic circles scribed upon the ground by the Scourge encampments, radiating the same dark magic that shields and sustains the necropolis looming overhead.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking outside the Undercity?
faq.answer: The Lich King seeks to eradicate the renegade Forsaken and conquer the ruins of Lordaeron, deploying necropolises and ground troops to besiege the capital directly.

faq.q: Why does this matter to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Forsaken fought tirelessly to break free of the Lich King's iron will. The Scourge landing at their very threshold threatens the freedom and sovereignty of their fledgling nation.

faq.q: Can non-Forsaken Horde members take this mission?
faq.answer: Yes. All members of the Horde are summoned to aid in Lordaeron's defense, as a threat to the Undercity threatens the security of the entire coalition.

angles.text: The Scourge represents your former master and perpetual enslaver; repelling them from Lordaeron's soil is a matter of pure survival and vengeance.
Honor demands coming to the defense of the Forsaken, securing the Horde's vital foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms against the Scourge.
